details: Iran initiated drone attacks targeting a US air defense radar at the Al-Rifaa helicopter base in Bahrain on Sunday, November 15th, marking the second such incident in three days. Bahraini authorities reported intercepting the drones. This escalation is intensifying geopolitical risks, casting further doubt on US-Iran peace talks, and raising concerns about regional stability, which is contributing to increased risk premiums across global markets.
title: Iran Launches Drone Attacks on US Military Base in Bahrain

details: On November 16th, the US Commerce Department issued new rules mandating export licenses for advanced AI chips shipped to data centers globally if they supply significant computing power to companies headquartered in China or other designated "countries of concern." This measure aims to prevent circumvention of existing technology restrictions through remote access via data centers in countries like Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Brazil, following recent scrutiny over chip supply and the Nvidia scandal.
title: US Tightens AI Chip Export Controls, Restricting China's Access

details: The broader cryptocurrency market remained under pressure, with Bitcoin recovering slightly to $65,000 on November 15th after briefly dipping near $62,000. Ethereum, Solana, and other major digital assets also struggled. The volatile market was influenced by institutional withdrawals, forced liquidations exceeding $2 billion over the weekend, and expectations of higher US interest rates, contributing to a total cryptocurrency market capitalization fall of approximately $130 billion since Friday.
title: Global Crypto Market Experiences Significant Sell-Off
